key_takeaways: 수동 타임스탬프 어노테이션 한계를 극복하는 SSL 기반 강제 정렬 평가 제안

en.title: Phoneme- and Word-Level Metrics Using Self-Supervised Speech Representations for Forced Alignment Evaluation
en.hook: Evaluates forced alignment quality without manual timestamps using novel corpus-level metrics derived from SSL speech representations.
key_takeaways: Eliminates the dependency on costly manual reference timestamps for forced alignment evaluation.
Introduces two SSL-based corpus-level metrics operating at both phoneme and word levels.
Facilitates scalable, multilingual benchmarking of speech alignment architectures.
